none: PAS FindID 957559: Roman Coin: Radiate of Tetricus II
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Irregular radiate of Tetricus II (272-274), cf. Cunetio no. 3033:1. Obverse description: Beardless radiate bust right. Obverse inscription: (--)TETRICVS AVG. Reverse description: Spes standing left, as a swirling Celtic version with breasts and hips rendered by paired curlicues. Reverse inscription: [SPES] AVG. Diameter: 16.8mm, Weight: 1.58gms, die axis: 6
